description: Expose cap_amount and the existing nullable currency_code consistently on shared/server tax-rate interfaces, correcting stale scope comments.
Extend shared money helpers with strict locale-aware decimal-text to safe minor-unit conversion using currency fraction digits and exact arithmetic.
Provide exact minor-unit edit hydration and currency-coded display formatting through the supported maximum for zero-, two-, and three-digit currencies.
Normalize and strictly validate PostgreSQL integer cap strings at action/read boundaries without accepting malformed or rounded fractional strings.
Validate the effective cap/currency pair on create and update; require an explicit supported rate currency for new or changed non-null caps, including zero.
Preserve omitted update fields, explicitly clear caps with null, and retain numeric zero without truthiness coercion.
Preserve unchanged legacy currency-less caps on unrelated updates and allow explicit currency resolution or clearing without guessing a currency.
Return localized action errors for cap syntax/range and currency-pair validation failures while retaining existing permission/product-access guards.
Add minor-unit cap and currency fields consistently to public base/create/update/response/advanced schemas and inferred types without update defaults.
Correct financial tax-rates GET to return normalized tenant-scoped tax-rate responses with its existing API guards plus billing-read/product-access checks.
Align API documentation and actual OpenAPI/generated schema consumers with cap units, nullable fields, omission semantics, and existing GET-only route availability.
Pass actual invoice or charge currency through affected TaxService callers in invoice generation and previews, preserving existing selection behavior.
Carry persisted caps into the preloaded billing tax model and reuse parent regional arithmetic in its compute adapter without changing uncapped rounding.
Add an explicit Tax cap column after percentage with No cap, currency-coded zero/amount, and unresolved legacy states.
Group Rate currency and the optional Tax cap input beside percentage in the existing add/edit dialog, with visible currency-applicability and blank/zero guidance.
Use the shared currency picker and validated metadata with universal, zero-digit, and three-digit options, preserving valid stored codes outside the usual shortlist.
Maintain raw cap text and original canonical values for exact edit hydration, untouched-field omission, meaningful dirty checking, cancel/reopen reset, and failed-save preservation.
Add Clear tax cap behavior that submits null independently of the rate currency and keeps an intentionally entered zero.
Require explicit cap re-entry when changing currency; show the change in rate applicability before saving instead of silently converting an amount.
Provide an unresolved legacy-cap edit state with the exact stored minor amount, an explicit currency-resolution preview, and a clear action.
Show field-associated localized validation for malformed, negative, excessive-precision, unsafe, and currency-invalid cap entries and focus the first invalid field.
Add accessible contextual help explaining per-rate contribution, per-segment reset, multiple invoice calculations, external tax, and the distinction from project billing caps.
Display cap and currency in Advanced Settings Details, with the same exact formatting and empty/legacy states as the list.
Show persistent composite-path limitations beside configured caps, in the edit form, and on Components without adding per-component inputs.
Gate create/update affordances and row-click behavior by billing permissions and pass read-only state through advanced detail editors.
Provide keyboard-operable clear/help controls, associated labels/errors, stable unique IDs, responsive layout, theme compatibility, and duplicate-save protection.
Add all cap/currency copy and validation keys consistently across supported service-catalog and billing-settings locales, including pseudo-locales.
Write the administrator configuration guide and update the parent contract for shipped UI/API availability, currency rules, scope, composite limitations, and open domain questions.
Verify shared CE/EE migration prerequisites and preserve parent branch ancestry without duplicating cap/currency migrations or guessing legacy data.
Record live UI and draft-invoice smoke evidence for set/edit/clear/zero, reload persistence, resulting totals, currency handling, and read-only denial.
